one_sentence_summary: Reproduce DFlash speculative decoding and analyze when it accelerates or fails across different benchmarks.
goal: Reproduce DFlash speculative decoding on several benchmarks and analyze benchmark-dependent acceptance and rejection behavior.
current_stage: Baseline reproduction and initial failure analysis completed.
confirmed_findings: DFlash provides large throughput speedups over normal decoding on GSM8K, HumanEval, MT-Bench, and Math500.
Math500 has the highest observed DFlash throughput among the listed benchmarks, reaching 458.8 tok/s compared with 87.53 tok/s for normal decoding.
MT-Bench has a shorter average accept length than Math500.
MT-Bench has a much lower full-block accept rate than Math500.
Early rejection positions dominate on MT-Bench.
tentative_hypotheses: Open-ended dialogue tasks such as MT-Bench may produce less predictable continuations than math reasoning tasks.
Math reasoning tasks may be more draft-friendly for DFlash-style speculative decoding.
important_decisions: Use DFlash benchmark results and round-level failure statistics as the first test case for Project Memory Agent v0.0.
Focus next on deeper correlational analysis rather than additional baseline reproduction.
open_questions: What prompt-level or generation-level features correlate with rejection position?
Why does MT-Bench have shorter accepted draft length than Math500?
Is the current failure analysis complete enough to show the PhD advisor?
next_actions: Run deeper correlational analysis on DFlash round traces.
Compare rejection behavior across benchmark types.
Summarize the current failure analysis for advisor feedback.

evidence.quote_or_summary: GSM8K 100 prompts: Normal 345.3s, 87.99 tok/s; DFlash 87.2s, 364.9 tok/s; accept length 6.449.
MT-Bench 50 prompts: Normal 217.9s, 87.79 tok/s; DFlash 86.5s, 221 tok/s; accept length 4.306.
Math500 100 prompts: Normal 752.4s, 87.53 tok/s; DFlash 149.6s, 458.8 tok/s; accept length 7.957.
MT-Bench round stats: mean commit_len 3.685, accepted_draft_tokens 2.685, full-block accept 2.87%.
Math500 round stats: mean commit_len 7.691, accepted_draft_tokens 6.691, full-block accept 18.92%.
